USAMO[edit]

The following AoPSers have won the United States of America Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO). Note that the definition of "winner" has evolved over the years. Up until 2022, the designation of "winner" was given to the top 12 scorers on the USAMO (but in the past it has been the top 6 or top 8 scores). However, this system has changed. Since 2022, the USAMO "winner" award no longer exists and has been replaced by the USAMO Gold Award, which is given to approximately the top 6% of competitors. In 2022, 19 Gold Awards were given. In 2023 and 2024, 16 Gold Awards were given each year.
